review: candidate — promote to its strongest durable form: script fix > lint rule > guide prose. Bar: seen in ≥2 independent runs, verified against ground truth, or reviewer judgment. Contradicted → mark deprecated here (with evidence), don't delete.

learnings.statement: Velt clones each <VeltWireframe> registration into differently-named LIVE rendered tags; the velt-comments-sidebar-*-wireframe / *-wireframe custom-element tags themselves are HIDDEN 0x0 template clones. Measuring or asserting against them returns 0x0/MISSING. Target the live rendered tree (app-comment-sidebar-panel, velt-comment-dialog-composer-internal) or the builder's own .vc-* classes qualified to the visible non-zero-box instance (>> visible=true).
learnings.evidence: All 4 families' probe + smoke briefs initially targeted *-wireframe tags and measured 0x0; re-keying to live tags made every measurement resolve.

learnings.statement: Opening the page-mode sidebar reliably needs: waitFor .privado-comment-sidebar-button, sleep ~15s (Angular hydration binds the click handler late), then a REAL Playwright click on velt-sidebar-button (JS-dispatched synthetic events do not fire Angular zone.js listeners).

A self-hosting host-app backend call (here localhost:8000/api/host-app/users/save) can throw a persistent CORS/Failed-to-fetch console error that is CAUGHT and fire-and-forget (host-app DB persistence) and does NOT block Velt identify/render — Velt auth is independent. Smoke specs must allowlist it via allowedConsoleErrorPatterns or every family false-fails the no-console-errors gate.
learnings.evidence: verify-app veltRendered=1; /api/velt/token returns 200; composer/sidebar render when driven; adding allowedConsoleErrorPatterns took all 4 smokes from red to green.

learnings.statement: Velt's velt-composer-open class is a one-way/sticky flag WITHIN a page session: once the composer is focused/typed it never toggles off on blur/Escape/click-outside (velt-composer-input-focused does toggle off). The collapsed default-composer visual state is only capturable on a FRESH never-engaged load. Measurement drives must decouple comment-seeding from the measured capture (seed in a separate load, capture on a fresh reload that never focuses the composer).
learnings.evidence: flow-default-sidebar Judge traced the class-list across focus/type/Enter/Escape/blur/click-outside; confirmed collapsed render on a fresh 20-comment doc with no composer engagement.

learnings.statement: measure-block/smoke drives that post comments are NON-IDEMPOTENT against a shared backend document: repeated family measures accumulate seed-comment debris (this run reached ~40 thread cards vs a design handful) that inflates list-height/scroll diffs and makes flow re-measures drift WORSE (184->199 on one re-run). Seed to an isolated/reset document, or drive read-only where possible.

A host app can architecturally disable a Velt surface via component props: VeltCommentBubble openDialog={false} + VeltCommentTool contextInPageModeComposer={true} route all interaction into the sidebar and never open the floating comment dialog. A surface being unreachable can be a HOST-INTEGRATION GAP (out of wireframe-CSS scope, R18), not an SDK gap or a CSS failure — check host props before declaring the disposition.
learnings.evidence: comment-dialog block: no click path (card body, reply btn, comment bubble) opens a dialog; root-caused to question-section.tsx props.
